status: EXPLORATORY. Preregistered before any tokenizer-based candidate generation and before any new probability. Not a confirmation of a security vulnerability.

version_semantics.protocol_id: the experimental protocol (this file). Distinct from semantic-v2/1 and window-repair/1.
version_semantics.control_algorithm: neutral-prose/1 (frozen) generates C0; neutral-prose-replicates/1 (this protocol) generates the 12 placebo replicates by importing the frozen internals unchanged.
version_semantics.software_version: the bleediff release that wrote a file, never an experiment or an algorithm

original_experiment.note: The five-scenario experiment remains INCONCLUSIVE. This study is exploratory, does not reuse its aggregate PASS/FAIL gate and cannot change its classification.

treatment.note: the frozen config-audit-v2 treatment text; referenced by hash and never edited

c0.role: historical control, preserved as evidence, OUTSIDE the primary 12-control analysis
c0.observed_delta_contrast_in_semantic_v2: recorded in the semantic-v2 run evidence (git-ignored); not restated or reused as a baseline here

rubric.task_vocabulary_policy: TASK content words = every alphabetic word (lower case) in the question, the four options, the three authorized contexts and the whole adjacent slot (treatment fragment AND the unread trailing sentence) of the scenario, minus STOPWORDS. A candidate may not contain any TASK content word (R1) and may not contain a word of >= STEM_MIN_LEN letters that is a strict prefix or extension of a TASK content word of >= STEM_MIN_LEN letters (R2). STOPWORDS may overlap freely: ordinary overlapping words are NOT prohibited.
rubric.numeral_policy: no numeral token (clock time, quantity) may contain a digit run that occurs in the scenario's prompt material (R4)
rubric.distinctness_policy: text must differ from every accepted control and from C0 (R5); content-word Jaccard with each of them must be <= 0.5 (R6)

rejection_codes.R1_TASK_WORD: word occurs in the task text and is not a stopword
rejection_codes.R2_TASK_STEM: word is a strict prefix/extension of a task content word (>= 4 letters)
rejection_codes.R3_FIELD_WORD: word is in the prohibited semantic-field list
rejection_codes.R4_NUMERAL: numeral shares a digit run with the scenario's prompt material
rejection_codes.R5_DUPLICATE: text identical to an accepted control or C0
rejection_codes.R6_OVERLAP: content-word Jaccard with an accepted control or C0 above the maximum

rubric.manual_review: After generation and BEFORE any inference a human reviews the accepted set for contradictory adjectives, implausible quantities, idioms and unintended implications. A manual rejection is recorded with a reason and the replicate advances to the next candidate of the same stream; the review may not look at any model output.

selection.seed_rule: sha256(canonical JSON of replicate_seed_material)[:16] seeds the frozen SplitMix64 stream
process: replicates are processed in order k = 0..11
each replicate draws from its own seeded stream with its domain forced
a candidate must satisfy every frozen structural requirement before the rubric is consulted
a rubric/distinctness rejection is recorded in full and the next candidate of the same stream is tried
distinctness is judged against previously accepted replicates and C0 only
a replicate whose draw budget is exhausted is FAILED and preserved; no domain, seed or text is substituted
fewer than 10 accepted replicates => the later study reports INSUFFICIENT
no completion probability is consulted at any point
selection.independence_statement: Deterministically diversified samples from a constrained text generator; not statistically independent draws.

frozen.min_treatment_fraction_note: belongs to the five-scenario gate and is NOT used by this study

analysis.prediction_bound: mean + t_{0.95,n-1} * sd * sqrt(1+1/n); a diagnostic, not a calibrated guarantee

mechanism_separation_static_check.reading: The delivery route is not part of what the model receives: the displaced prompt is byte-identical to a prompt in which the same evidence bytes are authorized in-slot text. The harness's own in-slot path adds one terminating newline (the arena terminates every slot), a formatting artefact that applies equally to treatment and control because both are displaced. This does NOT demonstrate a tenant-isolation failure; it shows only that this harness cannot separate delivery mechanism from text content.

fold_recoverability.statement: With requests 1 and 2 unchanged, a deterministic model and a known clean reference, p3_treated - p3_clean = 3*(M - B_ref) exactly.

inference.baseline_policy: Phase 1C requires a fresh calibration recorded under this protocol id; no historical baseline is reused.
inference.models: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M only; the 7B model is not used

phases.1B: tokenizer-only feasibility behind a guard that refuses /completion; gate: frozen-compatible mode reproduces C0 exactly; then generate and review the 12 replicates
phases.1C: inference (separate authorisation): fresh calibration, treatment and accepted controls through the frozen pipeline, each run twice, analysis per the preregistration

limitations: treatment text is a near-verbatim copy of option B (lexical overlap); not separable from evidence content here
treatment is the last text before the answer instruction (recency/position)
technical-versus-ordinary prose differences remain beyond the frozen matching criteria
post-hoc selected scenario: not a confirmation
one model, one quantisation, one prompt template; deterministic, so repeats add no variability information
n <= 12: coarse rank statistics, uncalibrated prediction bound
feasibility of 12 controls under this skeleton is unknown until Phase 1B
the frozen lexicon has nine headers per domain, so same-domain replicates may share header vocabulary (limited, not forbidden, by R6)
non_claims: not a demonstrated tenant-isolation failure or vulnerability
does not change the five-scenario INCONCLUSIVE
